title: bun build --compile leaks .bun-build temp files (120 files, 7 GB) plus stale refs
description: Three classes of build/loop remnants accumulate invisibly and need cleanup plus prevention. (1) BIGGEST: 120 orphaned .*.bun-build temp files totalling 7.0 GB sit in the repo root, one per bun build --compile run that never cleaned up after itself; they are gitignored (.gitignore:10) so they never surface in git status and grow unbounded with every release build. Needs both a one-time sweep and a fix so build-release.sh removes its own temp artifact on exit, including on failure. (2) 31 stale remote branches origin/cam/issue-* remain for already-shipped issues: the post-merge prune deletes the local branch but not the remote, so they accumulate every cycle. (3) A stray git worktree is still registered AND still present on disk at a /private/var/folders tmp path (main-baseline, detached HEAD), left over from a red-against-main baseline sweep that did not clean up. Verified live 2026-07-23. TYPE chore.
